title: The Beagle n’ Boots- Music City Stay
description:
Welcome to your home away from home! Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located townhome in a family-oriented neighborhood. Only 15-20 minutes from Downtown and Opryland. and right off the interstate to make it anywhere in Nashville. Whether you are in town for business or leisure, you’ll enjoy the convenience of all of our luxury living areas with smart TV and cozy furnishings, and spacious bedrooms ideal for families. 

NO PARTIES, NO GLITTER.

The space
This listing has cameras located in the front and back of the property.

Other things to note
This listing has quiet hours starting at 9pm and no parties, smoking, beer pong, or other destructive activities allowed (any evidence of such activities will result in a fine). This is a pet-friendly listing with a dog park and pet stations throughout the neighborhood. Guests must pay a $100 pet fee per stay if their pet(s) accompanies them during their booking (3 pet maximum). Please make sure to leash your dog(s) when taking them outside or you may face a fine typical with HOA fine. NO PARTIES AND NO GLITTER.
